limitations: Two and three fours are recorded all-shared-phase minima, not a damage receipt.
Both attacks were covered at search/release; post-turn expiry does not prove they were absorbed.
The living wood-attribute enemy absorbs fire at stop. Earlier dead enemy absorption colours are unknown; do not infer target colours from IDs.
Only the last three turns are retained. B2 traversal does not prove latent recovery ran.

Both recorded boards were searched with ordinary, selected single-take and multi-take paths at 48 steps and 800/2000ms, three trials each. No qualifying solution was found. This is not a proof of infeasibility.
r6 fixes authorization of weak B4 attacks; it does not prove B4 damage, subsequent cooldowns or a full clear.

recordedBoardProbe.clockScope: Multi uses stop snapshot 810 frames at 30fps / period30 as a conditional assumption for both boards, not live prior-turn evidence. Single remains within 48 moves. No native execution.
